finding.what: 'GAP SHELL · ONE RUN STAYS' points at a run that looks like the other 99: the followed run is not picked out, so 'a dot that cannot leave its shell' (part 1's picture) is told, not shown.
finding.why: Sink the other 99 runs further (0.40 -> 0.60, range 0-0.8) so the followed run is the brightest streak on its shell; check in round 2 that the three shells still read.

finding.what: The shell pin comes on 0.3 s after M3 lands at 81.5 s; R5 asks labels to cut on only after a settle of at least 1.0 s.
finding.why: 82.5 s gives the 1.0 s settle and still lands before the 0.24 row at 83.0 s (one new text per beat).

finding.what: After the cut to the chain the stage is empty except the tag (122.5-123.0 s), with no caption: reads as a dropped frame.
finding.why: Start the chain's count-in on the cut (123.0 -> 122.5) so the cut lands on marks.

finding.what: The chain is the smallest cloud in the film (about 110 px wide at thumb, a quarter of the free stage), so its turn and its ghost are hard to compare.
finding.why: 130 -> 150 world units grows it about 15 %; its right edge stays near x = 200 px, far from the panel at about 326 px. Round 2 checks the tag and the caption band stay clear.
